strings.zh: 浅红市的南面就是大海了,{NEWLINE}在海面上有座名为双子岛的小岛,{CLEAR}传说创造大海的精灵就在双子岛沉睡。{CLEAR}为了抑制那只精灵的强大力量,{CLEAR}双子岛才会常年冰封,{CLEAR}以至于让人难以接近。
strings.en: South of Fuchsia City is the sea. Out on{NEWLINE}the water lie the Seafoam Islands.{CLEAR}Legend says the Pokémon that created{CLEAR}the seas sleeps there.{SCROLL}To hold back that Pokémon’s immense{NEWLINE}power, the Seafoam Islands stay frozen{CLEAR}all year round, which makes them hard{CLEAR}to approach.

strings.zh: 我在浅红道馆学会了变身术！{NEWLINE}哈哈哈！{SCROLL}
strings.en: I learned the art of transformation at{NEWLINE}the Fuchsia Gym! Ha ha ha!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 看,很像吧？{SCROLL}……{SCROLL}唉？完全没有变！？{NEWLINE}好失望啊。
strings.en: See? Looks just like him, right?{SCROLL}...{SCROLL}Huh? Nothing changed at all?! What a{NEWLINE}letdown.

strings.zh: 小绿『我去彩虹道馆挑战的时候{NEWLINE}居然遇到了好几个馆主！{CLEAR}简直就像是忍者用的分身之术。{CLEAR}我打到精疲力竭也没找出真正的馆主,{CLEAR}依我看这些分身里压根就没有馆主吧。
strings.en: Blue: When I went to challenge the{NEWLINE}Fuchsia Gym, I found a whole bunch of{CLEAR}Gym Leaders there! Like some ninja{CLEAR}clone trick.{SCROLL}I battled till I was worn out and never{NEWLINE}found the real one. If you ask me, the{CLEAR}real Leader wasn’t even among them.
strings.notes: D-1195: reverted to match the zh (Blue names 彩虹道馆 (Celadon Gym) but describes the Fuchsia Gym’s Koga clones); logged in hack_findings_import.jsonl | Hack text error fixed with user approval (D-0659, D-1496).

strings.zh: 小绿『哦？真的馆主现身了？{NEWLINE}还邀请咱们去挑战？{CLEAR}哼,终于不用在假扮者里找来找去了。{SCROLL}小绿『我这就去教训一下{NEWLINE}这个喜欢给人添麻烦的馆主。
strings.en: Blue: Oh? The real Leader showed up?{NEWLINE}And he invited us to challenge him?{CLEAR}Hmph, finally I don’t have to hunt{CLEAR}through a bunch of impostors.{SCROLL}Blue: I’m off to teach that{NEWLINE}pain-in-the-neck Leader a lesson.

strings.zh: 看你眼神坚毅,还以为你跟我一样{NEWLINE}也是个硬派训练家呢。
strings.en: You’ve got such determined eyes, I{NEWLINE}figured you were a hard-core Trainer{CLEAR}like me.

strings.zh: 那你一定用得上这个技能机。
strings.en: Then you can definitely use this TM.

strings.zh: 尖石攻击比一般技能{NEWLINE}更容易命中要害。{CLEAR}善用技能说明里的特效{CLEAR}才能算是优秀的训练家啊。
strings.en: Stone Edge lands critical hits more{NEWLINE}easily than most moves. Only a Trainer{CLEAR}who makes good use of a move’s special{CLEAR}effects can be called great.
